catalog.title: Seiko JDM Catalog No.1 Supplement
catalog.note: Japanese domestic catalogue セイコーウオッチカタログ No.1 増補版 (supplement), 14 scan pages printed 3–14 between the covers. Each watch is identified only by a ◇ symbol plus a case–dial number, e.g. ◇GSC 901-901 (the footer asks dealers to order by symbol, number and price); ref = symbol-number in the site's JDM hyphen style (GSC-901-901, 10S-795-098), code = the printed line, caseDialCode = the printed number. Jewels (石) are printed with each model name. Prices are list prices in yen per printed material line (SS stainless, GC gold cap, SGP gold-plated, ASGP / AWGF = A-grade gold-plated / white-gold-filled, WGP white-gold-plated, 14KWG 14-carat white gold, PDP palladium-plated, CRP chrome-plated, APOP as printed on the pendant (ポケット), probably a misprint of APDP palladium-plated; WP water-proof; F and LB / MB as printed). No case-movement (CCCC-NNNN) refs and no bracelet part codes are printed. caliber is filled only where the symbol is the movement number (6245, 6246, 2539); family symbols such as 83BA, 765D, 66SA5 or 6660 are left blank. Dial colours are read from the photos. The twin scan '1966 Seiko V1.pdf' has the same 14 pages (renders match page for page) and was not digitised separately.
catalog.method: Vision transcription of the 250 DPI renders (Oct 2026), every caption verified against full-resolution caption crops; the PDF text layer (OCR) was used only as a cross-check.
